summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Ohmyhome Ltd disclosing the sale of all shares in its wholly-owned subsidiary Ohmyhome (BVI) Limited to Sterling Oat Ltd for $1. The transaction closed on May 31, 2026. The sale follows a debt waiver and release of SGD 19,019,173.33 (approx. $14.73 million) by the company to Ohmyhome BVI on the same date. The divestiture was approved by the board to exit the loss-making real estate brokerage business and focus on digital marketing services. The purchase price was based on the subsidiary's negative net asset position of -$14.77 million as of March 31, 2026. No advisor or premium is mentioned.
